units.source_text: 还有一个人不可忘记说了：那明石姬怀孕在身，不知近况如何？

en.t: There was one more person who must not be forgotten: Lady Akashi was pregnant, and how was she doing now?

units.source_text: 源氏公子时时挂念在心。

en.t: Prince Genji kept thinking of her from time to time.

units.source_text: 只因回京以来，公私两忙，以致不克随时问讯。

en.t: But since returning to the capital, he had been busy with both public and private affairs, and so could not ask after her as often as he wished.

units.source_text: 到了三月初头，推算起来已届产期。

en.t: By the beginning of the third month, by his reckoning, her time to give birth had already arrived.

units.source_text: 公子心中悄悄地怜爱她，便派个使者前去探问。

en.t: Feeling a quiet tenderness for her in his heart, the prince sent a messenger to inquire about her condition.

units.source_text: 使者立刻回来，报道：“已于三月十六日分娩，产一女婴，大小平安。”

en.t: The messenger soon returned and reported, "She gave birth on the sixteenth day of the third month, to a baby girl, and both mother and child are safe."

units.source_text: 源氏公子初次生女，觉得甚可珍爱，因而更加重视明石姬了。

en.t: As this was Prince Genji's first daughter, he found her especially precious, and he came to value Lady Akashi even more.

units.source_text: 他觉得后悔：为什么不迎接她到京中来做产呢？

en.t: He regretted it, wondering why he had not brought her to the capital to give birth.

units.source_text: 以前有个算命先生断定：“当生子女三人，其中必兼有天子与皇后。

en.t: Previously, a fortune-teller had declared, "You will have three children, and among them there will surely be both an emperor and an empress.

units.source_text: 最低者太政大臣，亦位极人臣。”

en.t: Even the lowest of them will become Grand Minister, reaching the highest rank a subject can attain."

units.source_text: 又说：“夫人中身份最低者，产的是女孩。”

en.t: He had also said, "The lady of the lowest status among your women will give birth to a girl."

units.source_text: 现在这句话已经应验了。

en.t: Now those words had already come true.

units.source_text: 以前有许多极高明的相面先生，异口同声地说：“源氏公子必然身登上位，统治天下。”

en.t: In the past, many highly skilled physiognomists had all said with one voice, "Prince Genji will surely rise to supreme rank and rule the realm."

units.source_text: 这几年来只因时运不济，这句话似乎落了空。

en.t: For the past few years, because fortune had not favored him, that prediction had seemed to fail.

units.source_text: 但此次冷泉帝即位，源氏公子宿愿以偿，心中欢喜。

en.t: But now that Emperor Reizei had ascended the throne, Prince Genji's long-cherished wish was fulfilled, and he was joyful at heart.

units.source_text: 他自身呢，原是与帝位无缘的，决不作此妄想。

en.t: As for himself, he had never been destined for the imperial throne, and he never entertained such a vain ambition.

units.source_text: 以前桐壶父皇在许多皇子中特别偏爱他，却又把他降为臣下，回想父皇这点用心，可知自己没有登帝位的宿缘。

en.t: Long ago, his father, Emperor Kiritsubo, had favored him above all his many princes, yet had reduced him to the rank of a subject; reflecting on his father's intention, Genji knew that he himself had no destined bond with the throne.

units.source_text: 但他暗自寻思：此次冷泉帝即位，外人虽然不知真相，相面先生那句话却证实了。

en.t: Still, he thought privately that with Emperor Reizei's accession, although outsiders did not know the truth, the physiognomist's words had been proven.

units.source_text: ——他仔细思量未来种种情况之后，确信“此次明石浦之行，定是住吉明神的引导。

en.t: After carefully considering all that might unfold in the future, he became convinced: "My journey to Akashi Bay must surely have been guided by the Sumiyoshi deity.

units.source_text: 那明石姬一定有生育皇后的宿缘，所以她那乖僻的父亲胆敢向我高攀身份不称的姻亲。

en.t: Lady Akashi must be destined to give birth to an empress, and that is why her eccentric father dared to seek a marriage connection with me far above his station.

units.source_text: 如此说来，这个身份高贵的皇后，教她诞生在这穷乡僻壤，实在委屈了她，亵渎了她！

en.t: If that is so, then to let this future empress of noble rank be born in such a remote, humble place was truly unfair to her, even a kind of desecration.

units.source_text: 目前暂且让她住在那里，将来一定迎她入京。”

en.t: For the moment I will let her remain there, but in the future I will certainly bring her to the capital."

units.source_text: 想定之后，立刻派人催促修筑东院的人从速竣工。

en.t: Having made up his mind, he immediately sent someone to urge the builders of the East Residence to complete it as quickly as possible.
